description:
“We’re in the middle of a change”. This interview is sponsored by Apple Pay! Check out in seconds on Fandango with Apple Pay!

Emily Blunt, Stanley Tucci, Caleb Hearon, Simone Ashley, Helen J. Shen, director David Frankel and writer Aline Brosh McKenna join Rotten Tomatoes correspondent Natasha Martinez to share how they reunited the all-star cast for the coveted sequel, ‘The Devil Wears Prada 2’. Blunt and Tucci discuss how their characters coped with betrayal in the last film and how it affects their personalities in this film. Hearon, Ashley, and Shen describe what it was like stepping onto set with Meryl Streep for the first time. And, Frankel and McKenna gush about easily Streep slipped into Miranda Priestly’s chillingly formidable confidence twenty years later. ‘The Devil Wears Prada 2’ hits theaters May 1!
